### About this job

### Job Description

Job Description

Thomas Printworks is looking for an entrepreneurial, results-driven ****Plant Manager**** who thrives in a fast-paced production environment and is ready to make an impact. If you’re passionate about building strong customer relationships, developing high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence, this could be your next career opportunity!

In this role, you’ll lead all aspects of plant operations, including production, team development, quality control, and overall performance. Beyond managing daily operations, you’ll have the opportunity to identify new business opportunities, streamline processes, and implement improvements that support long-term growth and success.

We’re looking for a leader who thinks strategically, inspires their team, and knows how to turn opportunities into results.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Lead and oversee daily plant operations.
* Direct and coordinate plant operations in alignment with company policies and procedures
* Communicate daily with employees regarding production schedules, priorities, and operational challenges.
* Partner with the Regional Vice President regarding plant performance, staffing, production, and customer issues
* Schedule and manage jobs to ensure quality standards and delivery deadlines are consistently met.
* Foster a culture of accountability, urgency, continuous improvement, and customer-focused service.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe production environment
* Recruit, train, coach, and develop a high-performing team
* Establish staffing and shift schedules to support production demands
* Address employee performance and attendance concerns through effective performance management practices
* Coordinate with purchasing, production, and delivery teams to ensure seamless workflow and communication
* Monitor and maintain adequate inventory and material levels
* Oversee quality control processes to achieve 100% customer satisfaction
* Complete end-of-day business procedures and required month-end reporting
* Maintain accurate operational tracking, reporting, and on-time delivery metrics
* Handle cash, credit transactions, petty cash, and sales receipt reconciliation
* Conduct employee performance reviews and ongoing coaching conversations
* Ensure compliance with all company safety standards and operational procedures
* Attend meetings and training sessions as required
* Maintain the company’s professional reputation through leadership, responsiveness, and operational excellence.
* Perform additional duties as assigned

****Qualifications****

* High School diploma or equivalent required
* Minimum of 5 years of printing industry experience required
* Proven leadership experience in a production, print, or operations environment
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
* Strong customer service and relationship-building skills
* Ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize workflow and meet deadlines
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Adobe Acrobat
* Strong math and inventory management skills
* Reliable transportation required
* Flexible schedule availability, including weekends as needed
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

****What We’re Looking For****

* Thinks proactively and looks for ways to improve operations and grow the business
* Takes ownership of results and leads by example
* Brings energy, urgency, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every challenge
* Builds strong relationships with customers, employees, and partners
* Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative and innovation are valued

****Our Values****

To be an organization committed to continuous growth, profitability, and values, where our customers recommend us, our employees treasure us, and our peers admire us.

Thomas Printworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employee applicant background check and drug screening required. We invite you to check out our website at www.thomasprintworks.com to learn more about our company.

**THIS IS AN OVERNIGHT POSITION**

Crown Linen is the leading commercial laundry specializing in the hospitality industry in Florida and Atlanta, GA. It was created to fill the demand for a professional laundry company dedicated exclusively to cater for the demanding needs of the hospitality industry. Today, it provides laundry services to more than 160 hotels (55,000 rooms) by emphasizing four guiding principles: quality, reliability, cost reduction, and customized service

Crown Linen is experiencing rapid growth, and we are looking for a qualified and enthusiastic Plant Manager to join our team.

**GENERAL PURPOSE**

Under the direction of the General Manager or Operation Manager, this position is responsible for all aspects of the Production department, plant safety, and maintaining an outstanding workforce.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for producing reports for Weekly Operating Report, Key Indicators, Payroll and Human Resources
* Planning, directing, and coordinating services in compliance with company goals and objectives.
* Daily/Weekly/monthly workforce forecasting to meet budgetary/volume/customer needs
* Establishing and controlling conditions of production/service to satisfy customer and quality and production specifications.
* Directing the shift managers in the provision and execution of operating strategies and plans.
* Organizing and directing workflow for satisfying production/service requirements in a cost-efficient manner.
* Developing and motivating cost-effective alternatives and improvements to the production process.
* Maintaining employee safety and morale by creating safe working and efficient working environments
* Maximizing the efficiency of production lines and ensuring effective employment utilization
* Presenting data and solutions to customers, both internal and external.
* Ensure that, as the company grows, processing capabilities meet or exceed all industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, and responsiveness.
* Execute a continuous improvement approach to ensure year-over-year productivity improvements are realized.
* Be responsible for setting goals and objectives for direct reports to ensure company objectives are met.
* Will be required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS/BA in Management or equivalent work experience; minimum 5 years operations/management experience - preferably laundry operations with large-scale plants in management or commercial field.
* High-level leadership and decision-making skills
* Able to motivate, influence, and train people
* Able to interact with all levels within the organization.
* Bilingual skills a plus (English/Spanish).
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally in verbal and written formats.
* Ability to multi-task and establish priorities.
* Ability to maintain organization in a changing environment.
* Ability to exhibit initiative, responsibility, flexibility, and leadership.
* Possess a thorough knowledge of contract administration and office procedures.
* Ability to use knowledge of the working environment to meet established goals and objectives.
* Proficient in the use of Windows-based office software including but not limited to Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Must possess a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record to be able to be insured under the company’s insurance policy.

# Forward Model Quality Chief, Underbody Systems Engineering, Vehicle Engineering and Design Assurance

Dearborn, MI, United States (Hybrid)

## Job Description

We are seeking a senior engineering and quality leader to join Global Forward Model Quality as the Forward Model Quality Chief for Underbody Systems Engineering, Vehicle Engineering and Design Assurance. You will be accountable for forward-model quality strategy and outcomes across a global vehicle program portfolio, leading a global team of GSR and LL6 engineers, including team members in Brazil and Germany.

**In this position...**

You will define the operating model for Prevent Action Closure (PAC), Failure Mode Avoidance (FMA), DFMEA, reliability confirmation, program assessments, deliverable recovery and compliance assurance. You will anticipate emerging risks, shape critical program quality decisions, and influence Director-level and executive leaders on trade-offs among quality, cost, timing and compliance. You will also build the leadership bench and capability needed for future vehicle architectures and technologies.

## Responsibilities

**What you'll do...**

**Strategy and Organizational Leadership**

* Set the multi-year forward-model quality strategy and roadmap, aligned with Global Product Development, Quality and enterprise priorities.
* Lead a global organization of GSR and LL6 engineers. Set its structure, resourcing, objectives and performance expectations.
* Lead talent reviews and succession planning, coach leaders, and build a diverse leadership pipeline.
* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, open communication and continuous improvement.

**Quality Transformation**

* Lead the shift from reactive to predictive, data-driven quality. Define the target-state operating model, standard work and governance routines that scale across programs and regions.
* Set the digital and AI-enabled quality strategy (analytics, automation, decision support) and drive adoption across functions to improve productivity and decision quality.
* Define the metrics and management systems (JIRA, executive dashboards) that give leaders real-time visibility of quality risk and execution.
* Sponsor process redesign and enterprise improvements that remove systemic barriers and are adopted beyond the organization.

**Quality Governance and Risk Management**

* Own PAC governance and the quality escalation framework across forward-model programs.
* Anticipate product and process risks and escalate strategic risks to executive leadership with clear recommendations.
* Sponsor cross-functional resolution of the highest-impact issues. Ensure corrective actions are systemic and sustained and hold owners accountable through closure.
* Represent forward-model quality in senior forums and report performance, trends and strategic risks to executives.

**Reliability and Design Quality**

* Set the reliability and robustness strategy through Program Quality Roadmaps so quality is designed in early.
* Own enterprise standards for DFMEA, reliability confirmation and the Robustness and Reliability Checklist, and evolve them for new technologies.
* Use field, warranty, teardown and test data to prioritize reliability investments and set B10 improvement strategies with functional leaders.
* Direct the high-mileage teardown program to find root causes of unexpected wear and feed lessons into design standards and future programs.

**Program Assessment, Planning and Recovery**

* Provide independent, executive-level assessment of program quality readiness and milestone deliverables and advise on gateway declarations.
* Own and evolve the Forward Model Assessment (FMA) process and risk-based audits, including AI-enabled tools, to cover emerging technologies and high-risk areas.
* Influence program targets, roadmaps, hardware change levels and new-unit quality selection. Communicate risk through Red/Yellow/Green assessments and recommendations.
* Own governance for recovery of late or at-risk deliverables. Decide on Moderate-3 plans, screen Major-5 plans for Director review, and address root causes to prevent repeat issues.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Partner with Functional Directors and Chiefs on Engineering Excellence actions and drive follow-up that lifts capability.
* Lead consistent deployment of engineering standards and sponsor strategic projects that improve quality effectiveness, efficiency and FMA adherence.
* Build mechanisms to capture and reuse lessons learned across programs and functions.

**Design Assurance and Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead compliance planning, reporting and milestone readiness across vehicle programs. Ensure deliverables meet regulatory and business requirements and anticipate the impact of changing regulations.
* Resolve compliance gaps, escalate readiness risks, and lead internal compliance audits with owned, root-cause follow-up.
* Represent Ford in NHTSA vehicle assessments and other regulatory reviews, as required.

## Qualifications

**Key Skills...**

* Strategic leadership and organizational transformation
* Global people leadership and succession planning
* Automotive product development, quality and manufacturing
* Failure Mode Avoidance, DFMEA, reliability and robustness
* Design assurance and regulatory compliance
* Enterprise risk management and quality governance
* Systemic problem solving and corrective action
* Executive communication and influence
* Data analytics, metrics and reporting (JIRA, Power BI)
* AI-enabled engineering tools and change management

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Significant automotive experience in engineering, product development, quality, reliability or design assurance, with increasing leadership responsibility.
* Experience leading and developing large technical teams or multiple levels of leaders.
* Experience setting strategy or leading transformation that improved quality, process or capability at organizational level.
* Strong knowledge of automotive product-development processes and milestone requirements.
* Experience applying and setting standards for DFMEA, reliability planning, Failure Mode Avoidance and structured problem solving.
* Experience managing quality risks, corrective actions, audits and compliance reviews with senior leaders.
* Ability to influence and align engineering, quality and program organizations at Director level and above.
* Strong analytical skills and excellent executive-level communication, turning complex technical information into clear recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across complex global vehicle programs.

**Even better, you may have...**

* Advanced engineering degree or MBA.
* Experience leading a global engineering or quality organization.
* Experience with transmission, driveline, steering, brakes and tire systems.
* Experience with vehicle regulatory compliance, certification or design-assurance processes.
* Experience with advanced technologies or complex systems integration.
* Experience leading adoption of AI tools, analytics and executive dashboards.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? **Build and lead the Garnet Quality function.** This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced quality professional who can establish the department while directly supporting manufacturing quality at Easton PA and Hillsborough NJ.

The successful candidate will create the initial quality systems, standards, inspection and testing controls, metrics, prevention culture, continual improvement activities, and corrective-action processes needed to support Garnet growth. In addition, they will be responsible for cost reduction, profit improvement, elimination of waste, increasing speed of execution, employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction. As the organization develops, this role is could expand into leadership of the full Garnet Quality Department.

**Primary responsibilities**

* **Build the function:** Define the Garnet Quality organization, staffing plan, responsibilities, procedures, training requirements, and implementation roadmap.
* **Establish the quality system:** Develop and maintain practical QMS processes, document control, record retention, and metrics.Achieve ISO 9001:2026 certification for the Garnet operations.
* **Own manufacturing quality:** Create inspection standards, control plans, sampling plans, acceptance criteria, hold/release practices, and product-release controls across Easton and Hillsborough.
* **Improve process capability:** Use SPC, data analysis, capability studies, yield analysis, defect Pareto analysis, and Gemba observations to improve process repeatability and product consistency.
* **Lead problem solving:** Own or facilitate root-cause analysis, containment, corrective and preventive actions, effectiveness checks, and escalation of significant quality issues.
* **Support customers and suppliers:** Lead customer complaints, RMAs, supplier quality issues, corrective actions, quality documentation, and communication of quality requirements.
* **Standardize the network:** Create common Garnet quality standards and best practices for Easton, Hillsborough, ensuring alignment with existing Coherent Global Quality Manuals, Procedures, and Processes.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, science, manufacturing, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Typically 10 or more years of progressive quality, manufacturing, or operations experience, including leadership of quality systems and problem-solving activities.
